title: The Devil Does Exist
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shy 17-year-old Kayano gives a love letter meant for her crush to the wrong boy: Takeru, the principal's son and leader of the school's delinquents, who teases her mercilessly. Then her mother announces she is marrying the principal, making Takeru her stepbrother and housemate. A love triangle with basketball captain Kamijo follows.
life_message: A good life means seeing past a rough exterior and choosing love honestly, even against family complications.

content.note: Delinquent setting; no notable violence in summaries (to verify).

High-school romance between stepsiblings who live together (not blood relatives; MangaUpdates Stepsibling Love, AniList Inseki), plus a love triangle. Explicitness unconfirmed.
